title: P1b smoke: hypothesis-first with enforced tool evidence
kind: P1b single-variable tool-evidence enforcement; discovery only
hypothesis: P1 failed because checked was self-reported and the hypothesis arm made zero real tool reads. Requiring one real read (with one bounded retry) should increase tool use and recover or maintain candidate recall; if the retry still reads nothing, findings must be dropped rather than trusted.
selection_reason: One no-candidate case (tornado-3), the baseline candidate hit (youtube-dl-4), and an off-target case (youtube-dl-8); both sides, one r0 window per side, six windows per arm.
metrics: reference candidate recall on the 3 cases
real tool reads and bounded retries
findings dropped for missing tool evidence
adoption: At least one more candidate hit than baseline with real tool reads and no fixed-side alarm; or, at minimum, restore the youtube-dl-4 hit while adding real reads. A six-window smoke is exploratory; a gain requires the full 18-window development set and a repeat before adoption.
scope: Discovery only; no evidence engine, official tests/labels/opposite version in the Agent input. One repetition; all requests, failures and dropped findings retained.
